title: Rabbi Chanina bar Idi (a Tanna of a Baraita)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) In Shevuot 35b: “It was taught: Rabbi Chanina bar Idi says: Since the Torah said ‘swear,’” etc. It is cited in the Sifra, Kedoshim, section 102, and there he disagrees with Rabbi Achi bar Yoshiyah. The statement is likewise cited in the Mekhilta, Mishpatim, chapter 5, and there Rabbi Achai. In the Mekhilta, Beshalach, Massekhta deAmalek, chapter 2: “Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai … Rabbi Chananyah ben Idi says: Moses was weeping … others say,” etc. Hyman criticizes Seder HaDorot for confusing the Tanna and the Amora together and needlessly criticizing Yuchasin, for Yuchasin cites “Rabbi Chanina bar Idi said that Shmuel said,” and that there is a Tanna of a baraita in chapter Shevuot HaEdut so named. Hyman endorses Yuchasin, explaining that Yuchasin learned that he spoke in Shmuel’s name from Avodah Zarah 40a; see also the entry Rav Chinena bar Idi.

notes.text: Hyman’s distinction between the Tanna and Amora and criticism of Seder HaDorot retain their attribution. The full names and competing Achai/Achi forms are not harmonized.

The consulted Shevuot 35b directly names Rabbi Chanina bar Idi. This does not independently verify the exact Sifra, Mekhilta, Yuchasin or Seder HaDorot passages or establish an identity between the Tanna and the Amora.
